notes.text: The page presents twelve principal avatars of the Teichmüller tower in a vertical diagram: nine main labels and three primed variants. It supplies descriptive captions and operations/decomposition notes, without proving the relationships drawn.

Counting the nine main objects and the three primed objects gives twelve, in agreement with the written heading. Only this enumeration was checked mathematically; no theorem about the category changes or the ten operations/pieces was proved from this isolated page.

The final stroke in Tours may be an s even after la. The possible mismatch is preserved, not repaired by French agreement. Singular topologique, analytique and géodésique are retained from their visible endings.

The short arrow above the left four-line annotation does not have a shaft through the annotation to the primed analytic object. The transcription keeps the short arrow literally and does not manufacture the longer map supplied by C.

The topological and complex-algebraic captions have no visible closing parenthesis. The differentiable correction has two distinct closing curves: one in the cancelled old passage and one in the raised live replacement.

The pale blue-gray mechanical listing is laterally reversed bleed-through behind the front manuscript and is excluded. The separate pale number 42 is readable front foliation of unassigned origin and is retained in the margin.

H’s preliminary sheet description, layout synopsis, item-list punctuation and final section heading are editorial apparatus, not additional manuscript words. They were reviewed but not copied into the source transcription.

The analytic margin exponent-like marks, the propagation/cercle(s) wording, the descente/descendant wording and two possible cancelled initials remain unresolved. No expected mathematical construction was substituted for the ink.
